title: dubrueilia ciliaris
intro: Dubrueilia ciliaris, commonly known as Hairy Vetch, is a perennial legume plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as lowering cholesterol levels, improving digestion, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dubrueilia ciliaris are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
